mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an imminent monetary easing cycle that compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with 3 consecutive months of FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months with UNRATE exceeding 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deterioration in unemployment rate (rising above 4.5%) and industrial production (falling below 100 index) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE > 4.5% and INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing boom regime (HOUST exceeding 1500 thousand units), rising home construction activity signals strong consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month upward trend in residential fixed investment (RSAFS) signals strong housing market activity and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with 3 consecutive months of RSAFS increase, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months with CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (above 5.0%) and unemployment rate (above 4.5%) signal monetary tightening combined with labor market weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock regime (INDPRO falling below 100 index for two consecutive months), declining industrial production signals reduced manufacturing output and economic contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
